title: 数据联动的销售仪表盘
prompt: “看近一个月销售趋势，能筛区域，并看明细排名。”
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, footer])
$region = "全部"
$showRanking = false
intro = Col([Row([Title("近30天销售趋势", "xl"), Badge("示例数据", "warning")], 3), Text("以下销售额、订单量与排名均为本地演示数据，仅用于展示区域筛选和图表的联动效果，不代表真实经营结果。", "sm", "muted")], 2)
tool = Card([Row([Title("销售看板", "md"), Spacer(), Caption($region == "全部" ? "全部区域" : $region)], 2), Select($region, regionOptions, "区域", "全部区域"), Grid([metricSales, metricOrders, metricAvg], 3, null, 2), Chart("area", trendRows, "date", ["sales"], "currency", "CNY", false, 220), Button(detailLabel, @Set($showRanking, !$showRanking), "outline", null, "sm", detailIcon), $showRanking ? Table(rankColumns, rankRows, "产品销售额排名", "top") : null], null, 3, 3)
footer = Text("切换区域后，趋势图、汇总指标和排名会同步更新。排名表为产品维度汇总，金额与数量均是演示值。", "sm", "muted")
regionOptions = ["全部", "华东", "华南", "华北", "西南"]
regionList = ["华东", "华南", "华北", "西南"]
products = ["智能手表", "无线耳机", "便携音箱", "平板电脑", "智能手环", "蓝牙键盘"]
baseProduct = [420, 380, 350, 310, 280, 250]
regionBoost = [0, -60, 45, -20]
dates = @Each(@Range(0, 30), "d", @AddDays(@Today(), d - 29))
sampleRows = @Each(@Range(0, 720), "i", {date: dates[@Floor(i / 24)], region: regionList[@Floor((i % 24) / 6)], product: products[(i % 6)], amount: baseProduct[(i % 6)] + regionBoost[@Floor((i % 24) / 6)] + ((i * 37 + @Floor(i / 24) * 53 + (i % 6) * 29) % 520), orders: 5 + ((i * 13 + @Floor(i / 24) * 7 + (i % 6) * 3) % 24)})
filtered = $region == "全部" ? sampleRows : @Filter(sampleRows, "region", "==", $region)
daily = @Bucket(filtered, "date", "day", "amount", "sum")
trendRows = @Each(daily, "d", {date: @Slice(d.key, 5), sales: d.value})
totalSales = @Sum(filtered.amount)
totalOrders = @Sum(filtered.orders)
avgDaily = @Round(totalSales / 30)
salesText = "¥" + @Format(totalSales, "compact", 1)
ordersText = @Format(totalOrders, "number", 0)
avgText = "¥" + @Format(avgDaily, "compact", 1)
metricSales = Col([Caption("30天销售额"), Text(salesText, "md", null, "semibold", false, false, true)], 1)
metricOrders = Col([Caption("订单数"), Text(ordersText, "md", null, "semibold", false, false, true)], 1)
metricAvg = Col([Caption("日均销售额"), Text(avgText, "md", null, "semibold", false, false, true)], 1)
detailLabel = $showRanking ? "收起明细排名" : "查看明细排名"
detailIcon = $showRanking ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"
productSales = @GroupBy(filtered, "product", "amount", "sum")
productOrders = @GroupBy(filtered, "product", "orders", "sum")
productRank = @Each(productSales, "p", {product: p.key, sales: p.value, orders: @Default(@Find(productOrders, "key", p.key).value, 0), avg: @Round(p.value / @Default(@Find(productOrders, "key", p.key).value, 1))})
productRankSorted = @Sort(productRank, "sales", "desc")
rankColumns = ["产品", "销售额", "订单数", "单均销售额"]
rankRows = @Each(productRankSorted, "r", [r.product, "¥" + @Format(r.sales, "number", 0), @Format(r.orders, "number", 0), "¥" + @Format(r.avg, "number", 0)])
